scene: Day 270, night, inside the dark gas station shop from episode one, seen from behind the counter. Through the cracked front window, three pairs of car headlights glare across the unlit forecourt, flashlight beams sweeping over the dark pumps, the red fuel can and a faded milk carton. In the foreground, Reed (blue-gray scarf) and Mara (purple forearm band) crouch low behind the counter, Mara pinching out a lantern; between them, crouching too, the Worker (plain mint-headed alien, dark suit, flat silver case at its feet), its pale green face catching the headlights. Above the door, the little entrance bell is swinging. What makes it scary: for 270 days they hid from aliens, and now they are hiding one from people.

Day 260, under the lit canopy of the gas station: the Surveyor (blue shoulder stripe, scanner on its hip) and the Worker (plain mint-headed alien) stand face to face over the counter, where the long receipt roll is unrolled; on it, a drawing of the dark ship with two joined circles inside and, beside them, three circles in a row joined by two short lines, glowing faintly. Reed (blue-gray scarf) and Mara (purple forearm band) stand at the edge of the frame, staring at the drawing. Through the window, the ship's dark straight-edged slab fills the sky. What makes it scary: the alien isn't taking its friend away, it's asking all three of them to come up.
